MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE
  Monday, May 2, 2022

1.  A regular meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Hepburn at 6: 30 p. m.
2..  Council Members  present:  Mayor Tim Hepburn
  Mayor Pro Tem Muir Davis
  Council Member Robin Carder
  Council Member Wendy Lau
  Council Member Rick Crosby

  Absent:  None.

  Advisory personnel  present:  City Manager Robert Russi

3.  Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Hepburn.

4.  Presentations/ Damien  High  Mayor Hepburn, on behalf of the City Council, congratulated and introduced
  2022  Damien High School Basketball  Team.  The Damien High School Basketball
  School Basketball
  team finished the regular season with a record of 26- 2 and became the
  Baseline League champions. The team qualified for the prestigious Open
  Division  playoffs,  the highest honor in basketball  Following the
  playoffs.

  Southern  Section  Open  Division  playoffs,  the team qualified for the CIF
  State  Division I  playoffs  where  they  went  4- 0,  defeating Clovis North to
  bring home the CIF State Division I championship. The team was led by
  senior captain RJ Smith, who was named Baseline League MVP and San
  Gabriel Valley Player of the Year. In addition to Smith, the Spartans got
  extraordinary contributions from seniors, Kaleb Smith, Bradley Xie, and
  Jimmy Oladokun.  Each was named All Baseline
  Spivey Word and Junior
  League honorees. The team was coached by Mike LeDuc, who, in December,
  reached a career milestone winning his 1000th game and was recently named
  California State Coach of the Year. The team was assisted by Darin Zabel,
  Eric Johnson, Andre McLean, David Ng, and Alex Arredondo. Below are the
  team players:  Each of the Team players received a certificate and an In- n- out
  gift card.

8.  Conflict of Interest/ Davis  Mayor Pro Tem Davis declared a conflict of interest on this matter because he
  owns property within 500 feet of the proposed vacation of public utility
  easements at 1941 North White Avenue and he left the Council Chambers.

  Vacation of Public Utility  Community Development Director Scherer reported on the vacation of a City
  Easement Located at 1941 N.  Public Utility Easement located at 1941 N. White Avenue and on the public
  White Avenue  hearing.  He stated that on April 4, 2022, the City Council set the Public
  Hearing to consider vacation of a City' s Public Utility Easement located at
  1941 N. White Avenue for May 2, 2022, and directed staff to post the
  appropriate noticing pursuant to the Streets and Highways Code.
  Mayor called for public comment on this matter.

  There was none.

  It was moved by Crosby, seconded by Lau, and carried by a vote of 4-0 ( Davis
  Abstained) to approve Resolution No. 22- 20, vacating the utility easement at
  1941 N. White Avenue and authorized staff to record the quitclaim deed and
  resolution with the Office of the County Recorder.
